description.value: Jang Mo Jib Restaurants is a Korean restaurant (장모집 外母屋) located on Kingsway in Vancouver's busy commercial corridor. The name references a traditional Korean concept evoking home-style cooking. It offers indoor seating in a non-smoking environment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a Korean restaurant at 5075 Kingsway with indoor seating and no outdoor seating confirmed via tags. However, the website at jangmojibca.com has been domain-hijacked and now hosts Indonesian-language online gambling/slot content (Broto4d, HK Pools, etc.) with no relation to the restaurant — this domain cannot be used as evidence for any amenity or contact claim. All amenity fields default to null; OSM tags confirm indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=no, and smoking=no.
concerns: Website domain jangmojibca.com has been hijacked and now hosts unrelated Indonesian-language online gambling/slot content (Broto4d, HK Pools, Yggdrasil slots). No restaurant information is accessible via the website. Contact_confirmed.website set to false.
No phone number available in OSM or via website.
Address lacks city, province, and postal code in OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: OSM record represents a real Korean restaurant on a major commercial street with no indication it is permanently closed; domain hijacking affects the website only and does not indicate the physical business has closed.
enrichment_extras.notes: All amenity fields are null due to website domain hijacking rendering the site unusable as an evidence source. Consider manual verification of the physical location and replacement website URL if one exists.

wow_evidence: Korean restaurant located on Kingsway in Vancouver's busy commercial corridor
